# `scripts/fp/coach/`

[Index](index.md)

## `scripts/fp/coach/coach_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

The coach card (integration feature "coach_card", flag coach_card): the first minute's guidance. A fresh city's welcome (Main asks over bus.coach_requested) is a key-cap card at the bottom centre, in the overview key bar's style: WASD walk, Shift run, Tab city overview, J AI feed, E talk, Enter chat, Esc menu. It stays 15 real seconds or until the player presses J, Tab or E (or does anything else first: chat, the menu, a hero action), and never shows again once settings coach_seen is set. A "Click to look around" pill shows while the pointer is free on a build that has one. A small ladder of one-line hints follows, each shown at most once (kept in settings coach_hints): the first AI decision (J reads it), the first resident within 3 m (E to talk), a minute without input at 1x (] speeds time up) and the first Tab (the Planner view button opens the full city builder). All text is de-branded street text: no model names.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `L = preload("res://scripts/fp/coach/coach_logic.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `FADE_PER_S = 5.0`
- `BOTTOM = 72.0`: Bottom of the stack above the screen edge in the 1600x900 base: clear of the overview's key bar.

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func card_visible() -> bool`: True while the welcome card is up.
- `func hint_shown() -> String`: The ladder hint on show ("J reads it"), or "".
- `func capture_pill_visible() -> bool`: True while the "Click to look around" pill is up.
- `func hint_seen(id: String) -> bool`: Whether ladder hint id was shown before (this run or an earlier one).
- `func show_welcome() -> bool`: Shows the welcome card unless it was seen for good. True when it showed.
- `func dismiss_welcome() -> void`: Ends the welcome card (a key, an action or the timer) and keeps it from coming back.
- `func offer_hint(id: String) -> void`: Queues ladder hint id: shown at once if nothing else is up (never twice, ever).

## `scripts/fp/coach/coach_logic.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The coach card's pure rules (feature "coach_card"): what the welcome card says, what the context hints say and when each shows. No nodes; the feature and the tests share it.

### Constants

- `SEEN_KEY = "coach_seen"`: Settings keys (FpMode.DEFAULT_SETTINGS): the welcome card is done for good once coach_seen is set; coach_hints lists the ladder hints already shown, comma separated.
- `HINTS_KEY = "coach_hints"`
- `CARD_SECONDS = 15.0`: Real seconds the welcome card stays up if the player does nothing.
- `HINT_SECONDS = 6.0`: Real seconds a ladder hint stays up.
- `IDLE_SECONDS = 60.0`: Seconds without any input at 1x before the speed hint.
- `TALK_METRES = 3.0`: A resident this near (metres) earns the talk hint.
- `KEYS = [ ["WASD", "walk"], ["Shift", "run"], ["Tab", "city overview"], ["J", "AI feed"], ["E",...`: The welcome card: [key, what it does], in reading order.
- `DISMISS_ACTIONS = ["ai_feed", "overview_toggle", "interact", "chat_open", "pause_menu"]`: Actions that end the welcome card early: the three it names, and the other first things a player does (chat, the menu).
- `HINTS = { "feed": [["key", "J"], ["text", "reads it"]], "talk": [["key", "E"], ["text", "to tal...`: The ladder, each shown at most once: id -> parts, [kind ("key" or "text"), text] in order.
- `CAPTURE_TEXT = "Click to look around"`
- `TOOL_ENV = [ "GRIDFALL_FP_SMOKE", "GRIDFALL_FP_PHOTO_DIR", "FPBENCH_DIR", "GRIDFALL_SMOKE_TEST", "...`: Environment switches of the scripted runs (smokes, photo tours, benchmarks, the trailer): their screenshots and timings stay as recorded, so the coach shows nothing in them.

### Functions

- `static func tool_run() -> bool`: True in a scripted tool run (see TOOL_ENV).
- `static func card_text() -> String`: The welcome card as one line ("WASD walk - Shift run - ...").
- `static func hint_text(id: String) -> String`: A ladder hint as one line ("J reads it").
- `static func should_show_capture_hint(mouse_mode: int, paused: bool, modal: bool, headless: bool) -> bool`: Whether the "Click to look around" pill shows: the pointer is free, on a build with a pointer (not headless), with no pause or modal UI that wants it free.
- `static func shown_hints(csv: String) -> PackedStringArray`: The hints already shown, from the saved settings string.
- `static func with_hint(csv: String, id: String) -> String`: csv with id added (once).
- `static func is_player_input(event: InputEvent) -> bool`: Whether event is a player's input (a key, button or pad press, or a mouse move), for the idle timer. Releases and echoes do not count.
